CustomField.description: Conditions that must be met to send the notification. Each line is a condition in format: FieldName OPERATOR Value. Multiple conditions are AND'd together. Leave blank to always send. Operators: EQUALS, NOT_EQUALS, CHANGED, CHANGED_TO, CHANGED_FROM, CONTAINS, IN, NOT_IN, IS_BLANK, IS_NOT_BLANK, GREATER_THAN, LESS_THAN.
CustomField.label: Conditions
